records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Orchard Labs* just joined on the team plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invites, no replies to two outreach emails (email:ccc480fe, email:cccc0102) despite a held kickoff (calendar:c8d271c1). Team plan + attended kickoff signals real intent, but zero product activity and silence suggest slow self-serve progress in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One next step after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Picking up where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project in place is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and once it's there you can invite your team from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you live and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
